sum: Everli Global Holdings, Inc. owns and operates a marketplace for online grocery shopping. The company's platform Everli, allows consumers to choose the supermarket in which to buy, order products, receive them the same day through dedicated shops, and pay cash at the time of delivery. The company was founded in 2014 and is based in Milan, Italy with operations in Poland, Czech Republic, and France. Everli Global Holdings, Inc. operates as a subsidiary of Palella Holdings LLC.
